user.title: Commute Tracker Setup
user.description: Configure your commute tracking options and household timing defaults.

data_description.name: Friendly name for this commute (e.g. Work Morning).
data_description.person_name: Name of the commuter displayed on dashboard cards.
data_description.person_picture: Image URL or entity picture for the commuter avatar.
data_description.active_sensor: Entity that activates tracking; avoids API polling when idle.
data_description.poll_interval: Seconds between live transit feed refreshes while active.
data_description.target_destination_time: Desired arrival time at your final destination.
data_description.prep_seconds: Preparation time before leaving the house. Offsets your notifications.
data_description.rollup_strategy: Strategy used to choose the best route.
data_description.route_late_buffer_seconds: Time to allow for a fallback route to be viable. Used in the Late with Buffer strategy.

route.title: Add Commute Route
route.description:
Configure a transit route option for this commute.

{stop_guidance}

data_description.provider: Transit authority or data feed for this route.
data_description.app_id: Application ID for transit API credentials (optional).
data_description.app_key: Application Key or API token for transit provider credentials (optional).
data_description.line: Line name or route number (e.g. 73, victoria).
data_description.route_color: Hex colour code for badges and timelines (e.g. #DC241F).
data_description.name: Display label for this option (e.g. Bus 73 or Victoria Line).
data_description.boarding_stop: Station name or stop identifier code where you board.
data_description.boarding_walk_seconds: The time you take to comfortably get from home to the boarding stop.
data_description.grace_seconds: The amount of time you can save if rushing to the boarding stop.
data_description.alighting_stop: Station name or stop identifier code where you disembark.
data_description.destination: Optional destination label displayed on the dashboard.
data_description.add_another_route: Configure an additional route option after saving this one to compare options on your commute.

corridor.title: Corridor Stop Configurator
corridor.description: Select the upstream corridor stops to monitor approaching vehicles. Stops are listed in vehicle travel order toward your boarding stop.

data_description.corridor_stops: Ordered upstream stops used to track approaching vehicles.

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to transit provider.
error.invalid_line: Line identifier not recognised by provider.
error.invalid_boarding_stop: Boarding stop not found along this line.
error.invalid_alighting_stop: Alighting stop not found along this line.
error.mutual_grace: Cannot specify both grace_seconds and grace_fraction.
error.no_routes: At least one route must be configured.
error.no_commutes: At least one commute must be configured.
error.already_configured: A commute with this name is already configured.
